source.title: Announcing our 2025 Charity Recommendations
source.statusSemantics: current ACE Recommended Charity in the 2025 recommendation set
source.coverageNote: ACE lists 10 current Recommended Charities: five awarded or renewed in 2025 and five retaining two-year status from 2024. Native metrics describe selected programs or outputs and are not organization-wide rankings. ACE warns that 2025 SAD estimates are not directly comparable with earlier ACE estimates or estimates from other organizations.

summary.fundingRoomPeriodNote: Annual incremental room published in each charity review; five values cover 2025–2026 and five cover 2026–2027. The total is descriptive and must not be read as a single-period portfolio target.

comparabilityWarning: Keep each program, species, outcome unit, model vintage, and uncertainty range intact. Do not rank across animal counts, meals, people reached, research outputs, or SAD estimates. In particular, ACE states that its 2025 SAD values are not directly comparable with previous years or with SAD values from other organizations.
